welcome.lead: Pick any no-talking template and upload your product images. A few minutes later the same video is ready with your product. No card needed.
welcome.leadPaid: Pick a template and upload your product images. A few minutes later the same video is ready with your product.

info.label: How the free video works
info.freeText: One no-talking video in Fast quality, one variant. No watermark, and you can download it. If the job stops, your free video comes back.
info.afterText: Every next video costs credits. You see the cost before each job; nothing is spent until you confirm.
info.creditsText: Talking videos, Best quality, extra variants, and turning your own video into a template.
